ap_selection_structural_probe.meaning: Actual candidate APs with the same unspecified zero action vector; structural selection check, no trained/semantic action adapter or control result

probe_protocol.preprocessing: Each fold uses only probe-training-site mean/std and target centering
probe_protocol.critical_limit: All frozen encoders were already trained on every probe scene. Only the diagnostic readout excludes scored sites; these are NOT held-out model performance results.
probe_protocol.numeric_gap_baseline: Constant fold-training per-cost gap mean; numeric_delta predicts misses only

interpretation_limits: High raw cosine is not constant collapse.
Low centered effective rank is concentration, not proof of useless information.
Latent axes and per-axis variance are not identifiable across checkpoints.
A failed linear probe does not rule out nonlinear information.
Single realized outcomes per action cannot identify irreducible future uncertainty.
Service encoder is untrained; its zero residual head is an initialization contract.
